text:
tess (product): Quick sync re: ephemeral lease pilot for payroll customer. They want per-route guarantees, calendared windows, and a clear preemption model. Need scope + go/no-go by Weds.

omar (eng-platform): Implementation options: ephemeral lease metadata on existing pools (fast) vs materializing separate pools (slow). Prefer metadata.

lily (eng-sre): Ops: preemption must be deterministic. Propose policy order: honor lease guarantees, then soft-burst (queue 50ms), then fallback model, finally 429. Need kill-switch + canary.

rik (billing): Billing needs per-lease export CSV: lease_id, route, window, tokens_used. Also reconciliation job and 48h dispute window. Propose surcharge for "no-preempt" days.

asha (sales): Customer will pay for predictable latency. They want SLA credit formula for missed guaranteed minutes. I'll loop legal.

omar (eng-platform): Rough estimate: 6d to wire lease metadata through router/scheduler, 2d for billing hooks, 2d dashboards/alerts. Can prototype in sandbox.

lily (eng-sre): Pilot gating: telemetry + audit logs, rollback toggle, billing export validated, and SLO dashboards. Ops oncall for first 48h.

tess (product): Action items: omar/lily prototype, rik draft export schema, asha track contract ask. I'll create epic and set decision deadline. :white_check_mark:
